create_gym_env: create a gym environment by calling gym.make with the given environment name string
create_env: create a batch of GymEnv instances with TimeLimit wrappers for parallel environment execution
create_train_env: create a batch of GymEnvInf instances for training with multiple parallel environments
create_agent: create a RecurrentAgent instance with a given model and number of action dimensions
run_experiment: run an A2C reinforcement learning experiment on CartPole-v0 using the Experiment class
